description:
THE DESIGN (v2, 2026-08-30, in cold review): analysis identity moves from
value-keyed activations to stable, body-derived names; evidence becomes
content. Supersedes this ticket's earlier 'dispatch-class roots' sketch --
dispatch classes are input-dependent and would migrate like arrows do; the
stable roots are cells and edges. Full proposal:
scratchpad/kdt74-proposal.md (session-local); this ticket is the durable
form.

## Why (the measured record)

- ~20% of AnalyzeActivation evals land on identities abandoned before the
  artifact (231/1081, 60/306, 120/886; recipe: fz2 interp debug, causal
  stream join of analyzed vs materialized keys).
- 98% of preservation churn is key migration (same function, new arrow).
- The caller<->callee fact 2-cycle is MANUFACTURED by key-level aggregation;
  it refuted three built designs (settled-wait folds; finality-first pop;
  live-edge demand over value keys -- see fz-kdt.69's refutation).
- The graveyard, so nobody re-walks it: cause-scoped mark_dirty (wrong set,
  no-op); declared body-strata oracle (blind to completion-time reads and
  hidden ascent state); per-callsite contribution jobs (epidemic moves one
  hop upstream); edge-derived demand over value keys (edge is a strict
  subset of stated demand; decommission non-terminating).
- BEAM's M:F/A: name is structure, everything else is behavior.

## The model

- CELL = (root, FunctionId); one AnalyzeFunction job per cell.
- EDGE = (caller cell, CallSiteId), syntactic and stable; root and
  runtime-demand seeds are SYNTHETIC EDGES so demand has one shape.
- Two per-edge facts: InputRows(callee_fn, edge) = tagged correlated rows
  (tags are caller-cell-local class ordinals, opaque to the callee);
  ReturnRows(callee_fn, edge) = per-tag returns. Callers wake only on their
  own edges. Per-edge facts dissolve the aggregation 2-cycle except under
  real recursion, giving fz-kdt.44's transitive finality a DAG to stratify
  -- the mechanism every refuted attempt was reaching for.
- CELL INTERNALS: rows dedupe by content into CLASSES (path compression
  lives HERE, cell-local -- the one place value-keying is kept);
  per-class walk (today's per-row walk, verified at jobs/semantic.rs
  ~:120-205); widening/convergence budgets act on class CONTENT (no
  resurrection hazard -- nothing to resurrect); keying erasures
  (closure-identity, convergence_collapse) become class-formation rules.
- IDENTITY AT SETTLEMENT: settled classes group by canonical_activation_key
  over settled values, minting today's ActivationKeys/ExecutableKeys; the
  backend does not change. Verified premise: today's ReturnType(key) JOINS
  across the key's rows (per-row returns are strictly finer); everything
  downstream of semantics gates on settled facts.

## What this deletes

SeedActivation + producer arms; the activation frontier + ignition scan;
Activation/ActivationInputs/ReturnType as keyed facts; ContributionMap's
analysis half; all preservation remnants; the abandoned-key population and
decommission problem. Dissolves: fz-kdt.64, .65's resurrection hazard, .72,
.80, .81, .82. Consumes the parked fz-kdt.13.2 watermark machinery as the
per-edge derivation substrate.

## Migration (staged; each stage lands-or-parks on its own evidence)

1. Cell skeleton, DUAL-WRITE (new facts derived as verified shadow; nothing
   reads them); instruments first: class-vs-activation counts, tag
   stability, old==derived-from-new equivalence auditor.
2. Callee-side cutover (reads InputRows; ReturnType derived at old keys via
   compat shim). Artifact must not move.
3. Caller-side cutover (reads ReturnRows; the cycle breaks; the eval win
   arrives here -- measure against the 57-real-revisions ascent).
4. Settlement minting + delete the old identity layer and every
   compensation mechanism.
fz-kdt.76 lands within 1-3 as its own story (under cells, truncation is a
row-content question). Cold review is currently judging stage-wise
landability; restructure so each stage retires at least one old mechanism.

## Open questions (with the cold reviewer)

Tag lifecycle under non-monotone row sets; recursion mechanics (in-cell vs
fact-mediated, budget placement); settlement-handoff exactness vs the
inventory pins; synthetic-edge ownership; the honest eval estimate for
stage 3; migration-stage safety under the determinism suite; the three
cheaper alternatives (69.3-prerequisites route / dispatch-class cells /
targeted fixes only).

## TRANSITION PROTOCOL (how we execute without getting lost)

1. THE TREE EXPLAINS ITSELF AT EVERY STAGE BOUNDARY; run the COLD NAVIGATOR
   drill between stages (fresh agent, repo+bw only, states the migration
   status; divergence means fix the record).
2. ONE TRUTH + DERIVED SHADOW, never two truths; cutover = swap derivation
   direction behind a standing equivalence test.
3. ARTIFACT CONSTANCY IS THE THREAD: canon byte-compare + inventory pins at
   every stage; only work-count claims may move numbers, never the artifact.
4. SCAFFOLD INVENTORY, CI-ENFORCED: every temporarily-live compat mechanism
   listed in one fact-engine.md section naming its owning stage; a grep-gate
   test asserts the list matches the tree; unlisted scaffolding fails.
5. NUMBERS CARRY RECIPES (lens, profile, fixture); re-measure anything older
   than the last landed stage; one RE-TRIAGE ticket at the epic midpoint.
6. THE GRAVEYARD stays in this ticket.
7. TICKET-FIRST CLOSE-OUT: rewrite (never layer) this ticket's state at each
   stage close, then report. Reports compact; tickets don't.
8. EACH STAGE retires >=1 old mechanism or is explicitly ticketed
   scaffolding; park is a recorded outcome (precedents: 77f87512c,
   9d65ab25e).
9. THE LOOP IS THE VEHICLE: cold design review for new ground ->
   fresh-context builder -> adversarial refuter -> land/park. Fresh contexts
   are the feature: they continuously test that the durable stores suffice.
10. STACKED DRAFT PRs per stage (PR #106/#107 precedent).
title: Cells at name/arity: edges as the interface, classes as the worklist, identity at settlement
